The company determined that efficacy and safety data do not support further development, as the drug would not represent a significant improvement over standard treatments. While the Phase 3 ESTUARY extension study showed long-term clinical response maintenance and acceptable safety profile, Sanofi maintains its 2026 financial guidance.
